notes: Added required stories for Recruitment Status measure feature.

EVAL-CT-M2-S1.title: Define Recruitment Status Score Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S1.description: Define normalized schema for clinical trial recruitment status (e.g., RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED) and scoring output contract including score value and explanation field.

EVAL-CT-M2-S2.title: Implement Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M2-S2.description: Implement logic to map trial recruitment statuses to scores (e.g., RECRUITING=high, COMPLETED=medium, TERMINATED=low) and handle unknown or missing statuses safely.

EVAL-CT-M2-S3.title: Expose Recruitment Status Score via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-CT-M2-S3.description: Integrate recruitment status scoring into EvaluateCare facade response so downstream consumers receive score and explanation alongside trial results.

EVAL-CT-M2-S4.title: Unit Tests for Recruitment Status Scoring
EVAL-CT-M2-S4.description: Create unit tests validating scoring logic across all statuses (RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, UNKNOWN) including edge cases and null handling.

EVAL-CT-M2-S5.title: Integration Test for Recruitment Status in Trial Results
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.description: Validate end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov API fetch through scoring to facade output, ensuring recruitment status is correctly scored and surfaced.
